title: Representation of a machine configuration
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $\mathrm{tr}$ be a transition function for a $k$-tape machine with Boolean work symbols and states in $\text{Fin}(n+1)$, and let $c$ and $d$ be configurations of that machine and its compiled machine, respectively. The representation condition requires that their input-head positions agree; that the first $k$ work tapes and their head positions agree cellwise; that the two additional tapes contain, respectively, the designated encoding of the transition table of $\mathrm{tr}$ and the designated summary of $c$'s output and state; and that both additional tape heads are at position zero.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{tr}$ is a transition function from input symbols and $k$ work-tape symbols to actions, with Boolean symbols and states in $\text{Fin}(n+1)$
$d$ is a configuration with $k+2$ work tapes and compiled states on input $x$
caveat: The snippet does not supply the definitions of the transition-table encoding or the output-and-state summary, so their exact contents cannot be stated.
